messages:
deploybot: :pushpin: Tag published: v2.48.0 -> branch release/2.48.0 (commit 9f3b2a4). Changelog (short): feat: prefix-KV cache eviction; perf: reduced decoder kernel path for long sequences; fix: retry on transient DB timeout. Canary plan: 1% -> 10% after 30m -> 50% after 2h -> full after 4h. Links: <https://git.redwood/repo/commits/9f3b2a4> <https://changelog.redwood/v2.48.0>
melissa (release): Nice, can you include the rollout window in the release notes? Also adding a pinned helm value request to prod playbook. :memo:
celeste: Quick heads-up from QA: we have a flaky test around vector-cache TTL that failed twice in staging. Not blocking but worth watching during canary. Details: test_vector_cache_eviction flaky on seq len >2048. :eyes:
jon (sre): Do not roll out to EU region tomorrow between 02:30-03:30 UTC — we have the DB migration happening then. Suggest gating EU canary until migration finishes. Also we should ensure fallback to 2.47.9 is ready if latency spikes.
paul (prod-ops): Acknowledged. I'll pin the image in prod chart values once canary looks healthy. Helm pin command I'll run if we greenlight: ```helm upgrade release-name repo/chart --set image.tag=v2.48.0 --namespace prod --reuse-values``` Will also update prod-ops runbook with rollback target 2.47.9.
maria (qa): Repro steps for flaky test posted in QA board. If canary shows increased 5xxs, I'll request abort. Otherwise LGTM.
melissa (release): Can someone add a short rollback blurb to the release note: how to roll back (chart pin + helm rollback)? Keeps on-call sane.
paul (prod-ops): Rollback checklist (short): 1) pin image.tag=v2.47.9 in prod values 2) run helm upgrade with --set image.tag=2.47.9 3) monitor token-level latency and error rate 4) revert traffic routing if needed. I'll paste exact commands when executing.
celeste: For QA visibility can we add a quick smoke prompt set to catch the vector-cache issue? e.g., run prompt with seq ~2100 and check cache hits.
deploybot: Update: tag v2.48.0 marked canary=ON in us-west (1%). EU gating flag set to false due to scheduled migration. Canary monitor hooks created (latency / 5xx / cache-misses). I'll post a status update at +30m. :rocket:
melissa (release): Thanks — I'll wait for the 30m snapshot before announcing wider rollout.
jon (sre): Note for on-call: rollback target image sha 7d2c1b9 corresponds to 2.47.9. If abort, set traffic back via routing policy in traffic-control service.
maria (qa): I'll be standing by to trigger abort if 5xx or cache regressions appear. Ping me in this thread.
paul (prod-ops): Pin request acknowledged. Will not promote to EU until migration complete. If anyone needs me to run the pin early in staging for testing, DM.
deploybot: 1973098840 status: canary 1% active us-west. No elevated 5xx in first 5m, cache-miss delta +1.2% (watching). Next checkpoint at 30m.
